crossRefs.note: He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
Saul summoned the people, and counted them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.
Again Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”
The children of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and went against them. The children of Israel encamped…

translations.web: King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.
translations.bsb: So at that time King Jehoram set out from Samaria and mobilized all Israel.
translations.kjv: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.
translations.asv: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.
